title: Xiaohongshu Exposed to Promote AI Shopping Assistant Function, Layout Front-End AI Products

content_html:
According to reports, Xiaohongshu is developing a new "AI Shopping Assistant" feature, which aims to recommend product cards directly in Q&A scenarios through a conversational interaction mode, with links to place orders. This project is led by Dao Xuan (Pan Boyuan).

At the beginning of this month, media reported that Xiaohongshu is accelerating its AI strategy, focusing on AI social products and AI community interaction tools. AI applications are rapidly expanding from backend technical applications to front-end self-developed, productized, and ecological solutions. Job postings show that Xiaohongshu has been actively recruiting AI application development talents, with some positions offering salaries ranging from 30-60K per year, and the highest annual salary can reach 960,000 yuan.

In May this year, Xiaohongshu announced an internal letter about a new round of organizational upgrades, establishing an AI first-level department called Dots and an Enterprise Intelligence Department, increasing AI investment from both product technology and organizational structure aspects. If the "AI Shopping Assistant" is ultimately implemented, Xiaohongshu may further explore the integration of AI with content, e-commerce, and community scenarios, promoting AI's evolution from a foundational capability to a product form that directly influences user purchasing decisions.

content_html_zh:
据介绍，小红书正在开发新的“AI导购”功能，旨在通过对话交互模式，在问答场景中直接推荐产品卡，并附有下单链接。 该项目由道轩（潘博渊）领导。

本月初，有媒体报道称，小红书正在加速AI战略，重点发力AI社交产品和AI社区互动工具。 人工智能应用正在从后端技术应用快速拓展到前端自主研发、产品化、生态化的解决方案。 招聘信息显示，小红书一直在积极招聘AI应用开发人才，部分职位年薪3万-6万不等，最高年薪可达96万元。

今年5月，小红书宣布了新一轮组织升级的内部信，成立人工智能一级部门Dots和企业智能部，从产品技术和组织架构两方面加大人工智能投入。 如果“AI购物助手”最终落地，小红书或将进一步探索AI与内容、电商、社区场景的融合，推动AI从基础能力进化为直接影响用户购买决策的产品形态。
